summary: Happy City Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that Nasdaq has closed a previously disclosed continued listing deficiency matter. The Company had received a notice on January 23, 2026 for failing to meet the minimum stockholders' equity or alternative requirements under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b), including the MVLS requirement. On June 2, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that the Company has evidenced compliance with the MVLS Rule and all other applicable criteria for continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market, closing the matter. No special situation is present; this is a routine regulatory compliance update. What to watch: continued compliance with Nasdaq listing standards.
